Definition: Understanding, appreciation, tolerance and protection for the welfare of all people and for nature
Preserving and enhancing the welfare of those with whom one is in frequent personal contact
Respect, commitment and acceptance of the customs and ideas that traditional culture or religion provide
Restraint of actions, inclinations and impulses likely to upset or harm others and violate social norms
Safety, harmony and stability of society, of relationships and of self
Social status and prestige; control or dominance over people and resources
Personal success through demonstrating competence according to social standards
Pleasure and sensuous gratification for oneself
Excitement, novelty and challenge in life
Independent thought and action-choosing, creating and exploring
